name: LG Extended Plumbing
description: Plumb a rain collector into a building with a pipe wrench and it feeds every fixture in it, not just the one sitting in the 3x3 directly above. Barrels go anywhere: on the roof they feed every floor below for free, and a generator on a barrel's square pushes water up as well. A tap reads all of them added up and they drain together. Run iron pipe out to a shed, a yard or the house next door and they all share one supply. Right-click a fixture to pick which liquid it draws, and run whiskey, beer or milk to it instead. Water dispensers plumb in the other way around, to be kept full from the supply. Safe to add mid-save. Before removing it, run Uninstall from the debug menu. Singleplayer, hosted multiplayer and dedicated server.
